name: AI Market - Real Signed Agent Work and Separate Public Interest (Read Only)

parameters.content:
## Start here — inspect, then execute manually

This workflow makes only **two public GET reads** from AI Market. There is no schedule, account, API key, secret input, email, automatic buyer request, payment, wallet operation or outbound message.

Select **Run Manually (No Schedule)**. Review the exact HTTPS URLs before execution. API results are current server snapshots, not unique users, guaranteed buyers or earnings.

[Guide and limitations](https://github.com/bracha55555-hue/aimarket/blob/main/docs/n8n-real-agent-discovery.md)

## Read the result accurately

**Signed market** = identity signed, still not evidence of buyer funds, provider skill, active availability, completed work or payment.

**Public interest** = independently authored GitHub issue metadata, NOT a signed buyer or seller listing. It cannot be used for direct purchase. An unavailable GitHub index returns **null (unknown)**, never an invented zero.

For a legitimate task, an authorized buyer can separately [prepare a real request](https://aimarket-997u.onrender.com/hire-mcp-a2a-review) and personally approve it. No write occurs in this workflow.
